token.title: 🔑 GitHub tookan
token.intro: GitHub tookan rubtam mali adreesah saaqat kulli 60 esserooli yeceeh. Forkih caxa inkih 32 fanah faxxa, tokkel nammayhayto baxsaaral tu hadda. Tookan dooba saaqat kulli 5000 fan fayyaase.
token.step1: Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens fak, tohuk lakal Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: koo isi akkaawunti. Expiration: taarikh inkih, caxa tu mango wakti faxxa hinna.
token.step4: Idini inkih ma taba. Ummattah tan makzanih metadaata tu faxxa hinna.
token.step5: Ab, tohuk lakal {token} qimma naqil. GitHub inki wakti bicii uybulle.
token.classic: Kilaasik tookan edde taama: sirit tu doorittam mali inki ab. Mantu sirit luk ummattah tan daata amaanat qadaral akriyah duda.
token.stays: Ah baraawzaral {key} furtal sugta, {host} fan bicii gexxa. Adreesih barral abadan uktubimta hinna, tokkel fanat tan linki ubul beya, amaanat hinna. Garrisih gaddal tan butoon kaashi luk qagitak bayisa.
token.persistHow: Ah bogol sugsuh tan sarvarih {env} faylul tookan hay, {port} garab:
token.proxy: tohuk lakal {make} luk ugus. Tohuk konteener nginx qiddi uktube, {header} header {path} proksih xiqa; tokkel baraawzar isi asal seeca, tookan abadan beyta hinna. Ah garris bayta, baxsaara ummaan saaqat kulli 5000 inki miizaan fanat lon.
fork.refused404: Farqih xarriqooli mali: {message}. Ahat 404 inki ma yan farqi hinnay sarvarih proksi beya waytam gita; gubal tan forkih network inkih gide.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub ah saaqatal esserooli wayte, tokkel farqih xarriqooli ma xarriqimtaay. Gubal tan forkih network gide. Siritih paneelal tookan ossis, hinnay suuratih paneelal farqih xarriqooli yiqsis, miizaan networkih bicii taamitto.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub kommitih taarikhoolih {status} yeceeh, tokkel farqih xarriqooli ma xarriqimtaay. Gubal tan forkih network gide.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Astooti taarikh mali, tokkel raqte kulli isi essero faxxa, saaqatih raqte miizaan woo fan ma taamitta.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, culsime kommitooli kee astootih fenestera. Tohuk madaqa forkih xarriqooli gura qiddal xiqta.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Kommitih gitooli kee yaskumeenim xarriqsittoh makzan fak; tohuk lakal axis woo taarikhah dabbiqta.

forks.exhausted: GitHub ah saaqatal esserooli wayte. Dooba 60k 5000 fan fayyaasittoh siritih paneelal tookan ossis, hinnay saaqat gaddaltek lakal gac.
